text:
maggie: heads-up — decode p95 jumped ~60% after merge 3f8c9b6. Canary shows it's only on shortseq traffic (N<=16).
perf-ci-bot: CI perf job failed: decode_p95 +63% (master vs prev) https://ci.internal/reports/4455 — test: decode_shortseq_a100
sam: thanks for flagging. i'm starting a bisect now. initial suspicion: kernel-selector heuristic change in f0a2 that prefers generic matmul for padded inputs.
lee: i pulled a trace from canary. see kernel switch right after kv-warmup:
```
# simplified trace snippet
step=1 token=0 kernel=attn_optimized ms=0.28
step=1 token=1 kernel=matmul_generic ms=2.14
step=1 token=2 kernel=matmul_generic ms=2.05
step=1 token=3 kernel=attn_optimized ms=0.30
```
maggie: exact same pattern locally on an A100 repro with model-52 quantized. tail tokens show repeated kernel handoffs that weren't there before.
perf-ops: this is blocking canary promotion. do we need a revert to unblock?
sam: bisect landed on commit f0a2c7d — it changes kernel preference ordering to avoid attn microkernel on padded blocks (aim was to fix a separate correctness flake). i'm preparing a minimal revert/patch.
jordan: quick hotfix idea: add a shortseq override: if kv_cache_enabled && seq_len <= 32 then force attn_optimized; reduces handoff thrash. patch: `if (kv && seq<=32) prefer(attn_optimized)`
maggie: running full perf sweep with that hotfix now (local x5 runs + canary).
perf-ci-bot: perf sweep jobs queued: decode_shortseq_x5, full_regression_x3. link: https://ci.internal/builds/4455/sweep
sam: also adding more granular logging around kernel-selector decisions so we can see why it chose matmul_generic for those tokens.
lee: fwiw the KV prefetch timing slightly overlaps with kernel selection now — could be a race where prefetch sets a hint that selector misinterprets. logging will help.
perf-ci-bot: sweep finished. decode_shortseq_x5: p95 back to baseline, no regressions observed. full_regression_x3: green.
maggie: rolling hotfix to canary and will promote if no other surprises. thanks all :thumbsup:
perf-ops: ok to promote to prod after canary hold 30m if stable.
jordan: PR up with revert and shortseq guard: https://gh.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/789 — description + benchmark results attached.
maggie: closing triage, will follow up with a postmortem note tomorrow with root cause + mitigation plan. thanks everyone!
